introduction: United Way 211 connects people with Missouri community resources. Phone specialists are available around the clock.
description: United Way 211 connects people with Missouri community resources. Phone specialists are available around the clock.

sections.who: Anyone can request a referral. Providers decide their own eligibility and availability.
sections.get: Referrals cover needs such as food, utilities and housing. Assistance is not guaranteed.
